_comment: Watch list for the rulebook change monitor. Each source declares how a change is detected, because the clearing houses signal differently. Index pages catch documents being added, removed or retargeted; document sources catch the text changing.

sources.label: LCH Limited rulebook index
sources.note: Prints a last-updated date beside every document. The strongest signal available across all six sources - it names which document moved and when.

sources.label: LCH SA rulebook index
sources.note: Dates shown for some documents only. Several filenames carry the version date, so a changed filename is itself a signal.

sources.label: CME Securities Clearing rulebook page
sources.note: No dates published. Diff the set of document links to catch additions and retargeting.

sources.label: CME Securities Clearing Rulebook (PDF)
sources.note: Overwritten in place, so hashing the file is the only way to see the text change.

sources.label: CME rule filings
sources.note: Filings normally appear before the rulebook PDF is republished. Early warning, not a rulebook source.

sources.label: ICE Clear Europe Clearing Rules (PDF)
sources.note: Stable URL, overwritten in place. Cover page prints a month and year - extracted as a readable version marker.

sources.label: ICE Clear Credit Rules (PDF)
sources.note: Carries a copyright and revision line that moves with each amendment.

sources.label: ICE Clear Credit Treasury Clearing Rules (PDF)
sources.note: Separate rulebook for Treasury clearing. Prints an explicit revision date.

sources.label: ICE Clear Europe regulation page
sources.note: Regulatory disclosure page, not a rulebook index. Watched only to catch new documents being posted.

sources.label: ICE Clear Credit regulation page
sources.note: Regulatory disclosure page, not a rulebook index. Watched only to catch new documents being posted.

sources.label: ICE Clear US regulation page
sources.note: Regulatory disclosure page, not a rulebook index. Watched only to catch new documents being posted.
